dataset.title: Overexpression of catalase delays age-related cardiac disease by preventing oxidative cysteine modifications

findings.message: 60 of the 60 channels of the search's TmtDesign.txt have no row of the SDRF naming their file and label, so their assays sit on the design's own sample (its `Sample Name`), with nothing known about it. E.g. `PXD002479:2013_08_06-LCMS-Yao-TMT-CatMouse-0001_130808000523:TMT126`, `PXD002479:2013_08_06-LCMS-Yao-TMT-CatMouse-0001_130808000523:TMT127`, `PXD002479:2013_08_06-LCMS-Yao-TMT-CatMouse-0001_130808000523:TMT128` and 57 more.
The search identified an unusually small fraction of the MS2 spectra. Treat absence of a protein in this dataset as weak evidence. Producer's note: 110/163293 = 0.07% of MS2 identified (S3)

no SDRF says which sample is in which channel (every SDRF was refused); PXReprise's default design makes each file its own plex and each channel that shows a sample its own sample; the reporter values compare nothing until a design is curated (QuantProject 079)
The deposited SDRF carries no biological annotation: organism part, cell type, disease and individual are all absent. Sample-level questions cannot be answered for this dataset until it is curated.

3 modification(s) could not be mapped to a UNIMOD accession or a mass, and are carried in ProForma as [Info:...] tags: UniProt:3'-nitrotyrosine on Y, UniProt:N6-malonyllysine on K, UniProt:N6-succinyllysine on K. Their ptm_sites rows exist and carry modification_name, with modification null, so a query by name finds them and a query by UNIMOD accession will not.

10 of the 10 files were searched as acquired, not calibrated (their names in the search carry no `-calib`): `2013_08_06-LCMS-Yao-TMT-CatMouse-0001_130808000523`, `2013_08_06-LCMS-Yao-TMT-CatMouse-0002_130808015549`, `2013_08_06-LCMS-Yao-TMT-CatMouse-0003_130808040039`, `2013_08_06-LCMS-Yao-TMT-CatMouse-0004`, `2013_08_06-LCMS-Yao-TMT-CatMouse-0005_130808081020`, `2013_08_06-LCMS-Yao-TMT-CatMouse-0006_130808101508`, `2013_08_06-LCMS-Yao-TMT-CatMouse-0007_130808121958`, `2013_08_06-LCMS-Yao-TMT-CatMouse-0008_130808142451`, `2013_08_06-LCMS-Yao-TMT-CatMouse-0009_130808162939`, `2013_08_06-LCMS-Yao-TMT-CatMouse-0010_130808183429`. Their reporter values are the same kind of number; their identifications rest on uncalibrated precursor masses (QuantProject 066, rule 3).

PTM site occupancy was not stored: this is a TMT dataset, and MetaMorpheus computes intensity occupancy for label-free searches only; its count occupancy is per file, repeated on every channel (QuantProject DEF-OCC-INT). `ptm_stoichiometry` has no rows here because of that, not because no site was modified.

dataset.summary: PXD002479 is a DDA isobaric dataset (Mus musculus) with 10 runs, 60 samples and no enrichment step (whole proteome). It was reanalysed with MetaMorpheus 1.1.14. At 1% FDR the search reports 110 PSMs, 0 peptidoforms and 2 protein groups, and the repository holds 12 PTM sites for it. 7 open warnings about it are recorded.

organisms_are: `organisms` is the organism of the protein DATABASE the search used, not a statement about the samples. Sample annotation, where any exists, is in the catalog's `samples` and `sample_characteristics` tables.
